scenes.say: 4 of my 5 reactor tests passed a wrong reactor model.

code: # CSTR, first order, A to B
scenes.say: My stirred tank reactor has an exact answer at steady state.
One test checks the algebra: tau = 500 s and X = 5/6, to 12 decimal places.
Then I swapped in the wrong formula on purpose: X = 1 - exp(-k tau), the plug-flow one.
Same tank, same flow. Conversion went from 0.8333 to 0.9933.
Moles were still conserved. Conversion still rose with volume. Those tests passed.
Only one test failed: the one against the closed form.
Property checks fit any reactor. Give every model one case with an exact answer.
